FN-3YIXEZV-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 117
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Matt Simpson
Commissions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/04/2025
House Bill 117 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Board of Examiners
in Marriage and Family Therapy until October 1, 2027 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law.
This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
